_note: Registration snippet — AUTHORING-BRIEF 'Registration protocol'. Content
agents do not touch content/manifest.js, content/manifest.json or
server/lib/rules.php; the integrator applies this and deletes the file.
ORDER MATTERS: r08 is the EIGHTH region of the fabulae track and must sit
after r07 and before r09 in the manifest's regions array — js/app.js
regionIndex() reads that order and feeds it to the phase engine as the ONE
difficulty input (DESIGN §6). Apply r07, then r08, then r09, then r10.
Regiō VIII · Hortus is an ORDINARY FABULAE DUEL region, so every number
below mirrors the r06/r07 block in rules.php rather than r05's: the boss is
Ventus, NOT the wolf (CURRICULUM §1 gives Lupus R1, R5, R9 and the R12
finale), so he gets the standard hp 6 / 70 phase-seconds budget — 22
caterva + 28 clamor + 20 fuga — and the standard rewards.
bossMinMs 15000 is the floor every duel region uses (region1, r02-r07).
The phase seconds are CEILINGS, not durations, so three clean phases at a
few seconds each is a fast child and not a forgery.
XP mirrors the fabulae track exactly: step 20 is the global default
(RULE_DEFAULT_STEP_XP) and is listed here only so the value is visible;
fight 30 and quizEach 10 with quizPassMaxWrong 1 are what r01-r07 use.
quizKey carries the same {q, a} pair per row that r03-r07 use: rules.php
stores the question word and the vocab key that must be picked, so grading
never depends on the order the client drew the options in. For a word ->
pick-the-image quiz the answer IS the question word, and `correct` is
always 0 against the boss.quiz order in content/fabulae-r08.js.
*** TWO CONTENT NOTES THE INTEGRATOR DOES NOT NEED TO ACT ON, recorded so
the quiz list is not 'corrected' back later. (1) The obvious sixth word is
`harundō` and it is deliberately NOT here: the boss quiz is the only screen
that puts cards from all three capitula on one board, and at 96 px a reed
and an oak are both green things on the same cream field. `quercus` holds
the f23 slot alone, and `arbor` is excluded for the same reason. (2) f24
ships SEVEN vocabulary cards, not eight — `quercus` was dropped from that
capitulum because the word appears nowhere in its Latin. See
content/_ledger-fabulae.md, Regiō VIII. ***
r08 is a NEW region: its content id IS its progressId, so it needs no
entry in rule_region_aliases().
